title: المجموعة السادسة: المستقبل والخطط والنية
status: 18 authored future-focused patterns, 72 translated scenes and three connected stories; realistic photographs intentionally deferred; sound production requires verified CI media

items.title: I'll
items.explanation: للقرار اللحظي أو الوعد أو التنبؤ؛ بعد will يأتي الفعل بصيغته الأساسية.
items.explanationEn: Use will for a decision made now, a promise, or a prediction; follow it with a base verb.
items.contrast: I'll help قرار اتخذته الآن؛ I'm going to help نية مقررة مسبقًا.

scenes.en: I'll call you after class.
I'll help you carry the boxes.
I'll send the address tonight.
I'll open the window.

story.en: Sara sees her friend carrying heavy bags.
story.ar: ترى سارة صديقتها تحمل حقائب ثقيلة.

story.en: She says, 'I'll carry one for you.'
Her friend smiles and thanks her.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: This box is heavy.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll help you with it.

items.title: I won't
items.explanation: ننفي حدوث فعل مستقبلي أو نؤكد رفضًا أو وعدًا بعدم القيام بشيء؛ won't اختصار will not.
items.explanationEn: Use won't to say a future action will not happen or to make a negative promise.
items.contrast: I won't go للمستقبل؛ I didn't go للماضي.

scenes.en: I won't be late tomorrow.
I won't forget your birthday.
I won't share your secret.
I won't buy that broken phone.

story.en: Omar promises to arrive early.
He says, 'I won't be late again.'
The next morning, he leaves home on time.
story.ar: في الصباح التالي، يغادر المنزل في الموعد.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Please remember our meeting.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I won't forget it.

items.title: Will you
items.explanation: نستخدم Will you للسؤال عن فعل مستقبلي، ويمكن أن تكون طلبًا مهذبًا بحسب السياق والنبرة.
items.explanationEn: Use Will you to ask about a future action or make a request.
items.contrast: Will you help? قد تكون طلبًا؛ Are you going to help? تسأل غالبًا عن النية.

scenes.en: Will you join us tomorrow?
Will you call me tonight?
Will you open the door, please?
Will you come to the lesson?

story.en: Lina invites her cousin to lunch.
story.ar: تدعو لينا ابنة عمها إلى الغداء.

story.en: She asks, 'Will you come on Friday?'
Her cousin says yes and checks the time.
story.ar: توافق ابنة عمها وتسأل عن الموعد.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Will you visit us this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I'll come on Saturday.

items.title: I'm going to
items.explanation: لنية أو خطة اتخذنا قرارها قبل لحظة الحديث؛ وقد يدل على توقع مبني على دليل ظاهر.
items.explanationEn: Use be going to for a prior intention or a prediction based on present evidence.
items.contrast: I'm going to study خطة مسبقة؛ I'll study قد يكون قرارًا آنيًا.

scenes.en: I'm going to practice English tonight.
I'm going to visit my grandmother.
I'm going to save some money.
I'm going to cook dinner at home.

story.en: Nabil writes his weekend goals.
He says, 'I'm going to practice every morning.'
He puts the plan beside his desk.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What are your plans for tonight?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm going to read a new book.

items.title: I'm not going to
items.formula: I'm not going to + base verb
items.explanation: لنُبيّن أن فعلًا ليس ضمن نيتنا أو خطتنا المسبقة؛ لا نضع الفعل في الماضي.
items.explanationEn: Use am not going to for a future action you do not intend to do.
items.contrast: I'm not going to travel قرار مسبق؛ I won't travel قد يدل على وعد أو رفض.

scenes.en: I'm not going to drive tonight.
I'm not going to skip breakfast.
I'm not going to buy a new laptop yet.
scenes.ar: لا أنوي شراء حاسوب جديد بعد.

scenes.en: I'm not going to watch TV before studying.

story.en: Mariam has an exam on Monday.
She isn't going to stay up late.
story.ar: لا تنوي السهر حتى وقت متأخر.

story.en: Instead, she plans to sleep early.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you buying a new phone?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, I'm not going to buy one yet.
dialogue.ar: لا، لا أنوي شراء واحد بعد.

items.title: Are you going to
items.formula: Are you going to + base verb + ...?
items.explanation: نسأل به عن نية أو خطة اتُخذت مسبقًا، وليس بالضرورة عن وعد أو قرار فوري.
items.explanationEn: Ask about someone's prior intention or future plan using Are you going to.
items.contrast: Are you going to call? سؤال عن النية؛ Will you call? سؤال عام أو طلب.

scenes.en: Are you going to study tonight?
Are you going to visit your uncle?
Are you going to take the bus?
Are you going to cook lunch?

story.en: Hadi sees his friend's packed bag.
He asks, 'Are you going to travel tomorrow?'
His friend tells him about the trip.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you going to attend the workshop?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm going to attend it.

items.title: I'm planning to
items.explanation: يشير إلى نشاط التخطيط الجاري لمشروع أو فعل مستقبلي، وقد تتغير التفاصيل.
items.explanationEn: Use I'm planning to for an intention you are actively arranging or considering.
items.contrast: I'm planning to move تبرز عملية التخطيط؛ I'm going to move تبرز النية.

scenes.en: I'm planning to learn ten new words.
I'm planning to visit Aden next month.
I'm planning to change my schedule.
I'm planning to start a small garden.

story.en: Rana wants a quieter study corner.
story.ar: تريد رنا ركنًا أكثر هدوءًا للدراسة.

story.en: She is planning to move her desk.
She measures the space by the window.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What are you planning to do next month?
dialogue.ar: ماذا تخطط أن تفعل الشهر المقبل؟

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm planning to take a short course.

items.title: I'm meeting
items.explanation: المضارع المستمر يُستخدم للترتيبات المستقبلية المحددة بالفعل، خصوصًا اللقاءات ذات الموعد.
items.explanationEn: Use the present continuous for a future arrangement already made.
items.contrast: I'm meeting Ali tomorrow ترتيب مؤكد؛ I might meet Ali احتمال فقط.

scenes.en: I'm meeting my teacher tomorrow.
I'm meeting my friends at six.
I'm visiting the dentist on Tuesday.
scenes.ar: لدي زيارة لطبيب الأسنان يوم الثلاثاء.

scenes.en: We're having lunch with our cousins on Friday.
scenes.ar: سنتناول الغداء مع أقاربنا يوم الجمعة.

story.en: Yousef receives a message from his teacher.
He says, 'I'm meeting her at ten.'
story.ar: يقول: لدي موعد للقائها عند العاشرة.

story.en: He writes the appointment in his calendar.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you free tomorrow morning?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, I'm meeting my teacher.

items.title: It starts at
items.formula: The + scheduled event + starts/leaves/opens at + time
items.explanation: نستخدم المضارع البسيط لجداول الرحلات والبرامج والمواعيد الثابتة حتى لو كان وقتها مستقبلًا.
items.explanationEn: Use the present simple for fixed timetables and scheduled events.
items.contrast: The train leaves at eight جدول رسمي؛ I'm leaving at eight ترتيبي الشخصي.

scenes.en: The class starts at nine tomorrow.
The bus leaves at seven in the morning.
The shop opens at eight on Monday.
scenes.ar: يفتح المتجر عند الثامنة يوم الاثنين.

scenes.en: The movie begins at six tonight.

story.en: Hiba checks the bus timetable.
The first bus leaves at seven.
She sets her alarm for six.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What time does the class start tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It starts at nine.

items.title: I hope to
items.explanation: نعبر عن أمنية أو رجاء بحدوث شيء في المستقبل، من دون أن نؤكد تحققه.
items.explanationEn: Use I hope to for a desired future result that is not guaranteed.
items.contrast: I hope to pass أمل؛ I expect to pass توقع مبني على ما نعرفه.

scenes.en: I hope to visit my cousins soon.
I hope to pass the exam.
I hope to learn English well.
I hope to see the sea this summer.

story.en: Salma practices every afternoon.
She says, 'I hope to speak English confidently.'
story.ar: تقول: آمل أن أتحدث الإنجليزية بثقة.

story.en: Her brother encourages her progress.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What do you hope to achieve this year?
dialogue.ar: ماذا تأمل أن تحقق هذا العام؟

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I hope to read twelve books.

items.title: I expect to
items.explanation: نعبر عن توقع لنتيجة مستقبلية نرجحها بناءً على معلومات أو تقدير.
items.explanationEn: Use I expect to when you think something is likely to happen.
items.contrast: I expect to finish توقع؛ I hope to finish أمنية.

scenes.en: I expect to finish the report on Friday.
I expect to arrive before sunset.
I expect to hear from them tomorrow.
scenes.ar: أتوقع أن أتلقى ردًا منهم غدًا.

scenes.en: I expect to complete the lesson today.

story.en: Bilal checks how much work remains.
He expects to finish before five.
He updates his teammates about the timing.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: When do you expect to arrive?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I expect to arrive by four.

items.title: I might
items.explanation: يشير إلى احتمال مستقبلي غير مؤكد؛ الفعل بعد might في المصدر دون to.
items.explanationEn: Use might followed by a base verb to describe an uncertain future possibility.
items.contrast: I might come احتمال؛ I'm going to come نية؛ I'll definitely come تأكيد.

scenes.en: I might go to the park after lunch.
scenes.ar: قد أذهب إلى الحديقة بعد الغداء.

scenes.en: I might call you this evening.
I might need more time.
scenes.ar: قد أحتاج إلى مزيد من الوقت.

scenes.en: I might study at the library tomorrow.

story.en: Nora is deciding what to do tomorrow.
She might visit the library.
She will decide after checking the weather.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you coming to the park?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I might come if I finish early.

items.title: I may
items.explanation: نستخدم may للتعبير عن احتمال، وقد تبدو أكثر رسمية من might؛ ولها أيضًا استعمال مستقل للإذن.
items.explanationEn: Use may followed by a base verb to express possibility. May can also express permission.
items.contrast: It may rain احتمال؛ May I leave? طلب إذن، وهذا معنى مختلف.

scenes.en: I may arrive a little late.
I may work from home tomorrow.
It may rain this afternoon.
We may change the meeting time.

story.en: Fadi hears that the road is busy.
He may arrive later than usual.
He sends a message to the group.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Will the meeting start on time?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It may start a little late.

items.title: I'll probably
items.explanation: نستخدم probably لبيان ترجيح أعلى من الاحتمال المفتوح، من دون ضمان.
items.explanationEn: Use will probably for a future event you think is likely.
items.contrast: I'll probably go مرجح؛ I might go أقل حسمًا.

scenes.en: I'll probably study after dinner.
I'll probably take the early bus.
We'll probably finish before noon.
It'll probably be warm tomorrow.

story.en: Amal has only two pages left.
She says, 'I'll probably finish soon.'
Her sister offers to wait for her.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you think you'll finish today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll probably finish before dinner.

items.title: I'm about to
items.explanation: نعبر عن فعل سيبدأ خلال لحظات أو فورًا تقريبًا؛ لا نستخدمه لخطة بعيدة.
items.explanationEn: Use be about to for something that will happen very soon.
items.contrast: I'm about to leave الآن تقريبًا؛ I'm going to leave tomorrow خطة غد.

scenes.en: I'm about to leave the house.
The lesson is about to start.
I'm about to answer the question.
scenes.ar: أنا على وشك الإجابة عن السؤال.

scenes.en: We're about to eat lunch.

story.en: Mona puts on her shoes.
She says, 'I'm about to leave.'
Her mother gives her the keys.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can we talk now?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm about to leave. Can I call later?
dialogue.ar: أنا على وشك الخروج. هل يمكن أن أتصل لاحقًا؟

items.title: If ..., I'll
items.formula: If + present simple, I'll + base verb
items.explanation: في الشرط المستقبلي الممكن نستخدم المضارع البسيط بعد if، وwill في جملة النتيجة؛ لا نكتب عادة if it will rain.
items.explanationEn: Use if followed by the simple present, then will in the result clause for a real future possibility.
items.contrast: If it rains, I'll stay home شرط؛ When it rains, I'll ... يتعامل مع حدوثه بوصفه متوقعًا.

scenes.en: If it rains, I'll stay at home.
If I finish early, I'll call you.
If you need help, I'll explain it.
If the bus is late, I'll walk.

story.en: Ali wants to play outside tomorrow.
He says, 'If it rains, I'll stay inside.'
He prepares a book as another plan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What will you do if it rains?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: If it rains, I'll read at home.

items.title: When ..., I'll
items.formula: When + present simple, I'll + base verb
items.explanation: نربط فعلًا مستقبلًا متوقع الحدوث بنتيجته؛ بعد when الزمن للمستقبل يكون غالبًا المضارع لا will.
items.explanationEn: Use when followed by the simple present for an expected future time, and will in the main clause.
items.contrast: When I get home, I'll call = عند الوصول المتوقع؛ If I get home early = شرط.

scenes.en: When I get home, I'll call my mother.
scenes.ar: عندما أصل إلى المنزل، سأتصل بأمي.

scenes.en: When the class ends, I'll go outside.
When she arrives, we'll start.
When I save enough money, I'll buy a bike.
scenes.ar: عندما أدخر ما يكفي من المال، سأشتري دراجة.

story.en: Lama finishes her morning tasks.
She says, 'When I finish, I'll visit Grandma.'
She checks that Grandma is at home.
story.ar: تتأكد من أن جدتها في المنزل.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: When will you send the photos?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: When I get home, I'll send them.

items.title: As soon as ..., I'll
items.formula: As soon as + present simple, I'll + base verb
items.explanation: يعني حصول الفعل الثاني فور وقوع الأول تقريبًا؛ وبعد as soon as نستخدم المضارع للمعنى المستقبلي.
items.explanationEn: Use as soon as followed by the simple present for a future action that follows immediately.
items.contrast: As soon as I arrive أقوى في الفورية من When I arrive.

scenes.en: As soon as I finish, I'll help you.
As soon as the bus arrives, we'll get on.
As soon as I hear the news, I'll tell you.
As soon as she calls, I'll answer.

story.en: Khaled waits for his sister's message.
He says, 'As soon as she writes, I'll reply.'
He keeps his phone nearby.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: When will you reply to my message?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: As soon as I see it, I'll reply.

lines.en: On Thursday, Dana writes down her weekend plans.
lines.ar: يوم الخميس، تكتب دانا خطط عطلة الأسبوع.

lines.en: She is going to visit her aunt on Friday.
She is meeting her cousin at ten in the morning.
lines.ar: لديها موعد مع ابنة عمها عند العاشرة صباحًا.

lines.en: If the weather is good, they will walk in the park.
lines.ar: إذا كان الطقس جيدًا، فسيمشيان في الحديقة.

lines.en: Dana might take her camera with her.
She hopes to make a happy memory.
Omar and Lina are planning a small class project.
lines.ar: يخطط عمر ولينا لمشروع صفي صغير.

lines.en: The presentation starts at nine on Monday.
lines.ar: يبدأ العرض عند التاسعة يوم الاثنين.

lines.en: Omar promises he won't forget his notes.
lines.ar: يعد عمر بأنه لن ينسى ملاحظاته.

lines.en: When they finish the poster, they'll practice together.
They'll probably be ready before Sunday night.
lines.ar: غالبًا سيكونون مستعدين قبل مساء الأحد.

lines.en: Hadi checks the bus schedule after work.
lines.ar: يراجع هادي جدول الحافلات بعد العمل.

lines.en: The last bus leaves at six this evening.
lines.ar: تغادر آخر حافلة عند السادسة مساءً.

lines.en: He might miss it if the meeting runs late.
He says, 'I'll take a taxi if I have to.'
lines.ar: يقول: سأستقل سيارة أجرة إن اضطررت.

lines.en: As soon as he gets home, he'll call his family.
lines.ar: فور وصوله إلى المنزل، سيتصل بعائلته.

lines.en: He expects to arrive before dinner.

skills: will و won't للقرار والوعد والتنبؤ
المضارع المستمر للترتيبات والمضارع البسيط للجداول
الجمل الزمنية والشرطية من دون will بعد if/when/as soon as
